questions.question:
Find out the two signs to be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

10 + 10 × 10 – 10 ÷ 10 = -89
questions.solution:
Interchanging the signs and using BODMAS rule,

Option A → – and ×

The original equation is,

10 + 10 × 10 – 10 ÷ 10 = -89

Interchanging the signs,

10 + 10 – 10 × 10 ÷ 10 = -89

Using BODMAS rule,

10 + 10 – 10 × 1 = - 89

10 + 10 – 10 = - 89

20 – 10 is not equal to – 89

**Option B ****→ × and ÷ **

**The original equation is,**

**10 + 10 × 10 – 10 ÷ 10 = -89**

**Interchanging the signs,**

**10 + 10 ÷ 10 – 10 × 10 = - 89**

**Using BODMAS rule,**

**10 + 1 – 10 × 10 = - 89**

**10 + 1 – 100 = - 89**

**11 – 100 = - 89**

**-89 = - 89**

Option C → + and ×

The original equation is,

10 + 10 × 10 – 10 ÷ 10 = -89

Interchanging the signs,

10 × 10 + 10 – 10 ÷ 10 = -89

Using BODMAS rule,

10 × 10 + 10 – 1 = - 89

100 + 10 – 1 = - 89

110 – 1 is not equal to – 89

Option D → – and ÷

The original equation is,

10 + 10 × 10 – 10 ÷ 10 = -89

Interchanging the signs,

10 + 10 × 10 ÷ 10 – 10 = - 89

Using BODMAS rule,

10 + 10 × 1 – 10 = - 89

10 + 10 – 10 is not equal to – 89

Hence, option B is the correct answer.

questions.question: Bananas turn brown in colour because:

options.text: an enzyme converts starch into sugar
the air reacts with the enzymes in the banana
Bisphosphonates reacts with the enzymes in the banana
an enzyme converts sugar into starch

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**the air reacts with the enzymes in the banana**__.

 
• Bananas turn brown in color because the **air reacts with the enzymes in the banana**.
 
• The life cycle of a banana starts with a deep **green color**.
 
• The deep green color of bananas changes to a **delicious yellow** and ends with a brown color.
 
• The unripened bananas are a light green color that begins to **yellow as they ripen**.
 
• Bananas contain an enzyme called **polyphenol oxidase** that reacts with oxygen in the atmosphere and coats the banana with a sort of rust that accounts for the dark brown color.
 
• **Ethylene** hormone helps for the ripening process.
 
• Large amounts of ethylene leads to the decaying of yellow pigments in bananas and it will change into brown color.
 
• The processes of formation of brown spots on a banana is called **enzymatic browning**.

Time is taken by G alone = 32 days

G leaves the work 8 days before the completion of work

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Time taken × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be LCM of 24 and 32 i.e. 96 unit

Work done by F in 1 day = 96/24 = 4 unit

Work done by G in 1 day = 96/32 = 3 unit
